messages.author: 6a9187372d721517
messages.subject: Import procrustes coordinates into MorphoJ
parts:
Hello!

I am running geomorph (4.0.1) in R version 4.1.1

I have imported my landmark data matrix and I ran gpagen, specifying which landmarks should be treated as semilandmarks on surfaces.

Everything runs ok but I was wondering if there is a way to save the resulting aligned Procrustes coordinates in a format that could be then be imported into MorphoJ.

I am trying to save them in a tsv table using
write.table(ecco.gpa$coords, "coords.tsv", sep = '\t')
but this format is not recognized by MorphoJ.

Do you have any suggestion on what I could do instead?

Best regards, 

Christina

messages.author: e358c6bea2b9961c
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Import procrustes coordinates into MorphoJ
parts:
Hi Christina,

it is actually possible and quite simple to import coordinates from geomorph in MorphoJ.

You need to wriyte a csv using this line of code:

write.csv(two.d.array(gpa$coords), file = "landmarks.csv")

Then you need to open the file in excel and delte the first row which will contain something like X.1, Y.1, Z.1. MorphoJ should be able to read the file anyway but it's not really necessary.

After that you can import it into MorphoJ by creatinga new dataset.

Hoep this helps,
best
Agnese
